SELECT teacher.Name
FROM teacher
JOIN course_arrange ON teacher.Teacher_ID = course_arrange.Teacher_ID
JOIN course ON course.Course_ID = course_arrange.Course_ID
WHERE course.Course LIKE '%math%';
